landing.metaDescription: Monitor what is said about your brand, candidate, or government in news and social media — sentiment, trends, and reputational risk alerts in real time.
landing.heroBody:
Unicornio identifies shifts, narratives, perception, key actors, risks, and opportunities
to help you understand what is happening and what deserves your attention.
landing.heroImageAlt: Sentiment Unicornio dashboard showing mentions, positive/negative sentiment, and keywords
landing.featuresTitle: Understand how the conversation evolves around your brand, institution, or public figure.
landing.stackDetectBody: Spot meaningful shifts in topics, perception, actors, and conversation.
landing.stackContextBody: See what is behind those changes and how they are evolving.
landing.stackPriorityBody: Separate relevant signals from the noise.
landing.stackRiskBody: Recognize emerging conversations that may need attention.

landing.featureSarcasmBody: AI trained to understand sarcastic narratives, idioms, and regional slang, giving you the most accurate sentiment measurement.
landing.featureAlertsBody: Detect spikes in negative sentiment, growing hashtags, and contingency situations in real time.

landing.simplifyProblemTitle: More information doesn't always mean more intelligence.
landing.simplifyProblemBody: Every day brings new mentions, comments, news, posts, actors, and narratives. The real challenge isn't just monitoring them. It's understanding what changed, why it matters, who's involved, and how the conversation is evolving.
landing.simplifyPillarPriorityBody: Separate what matters from the noise.

landing.simplifyTitle: Unicornio helps you understand what is changing in the conversation and focus on what actually matters.

landing.simplifyDocNoisyP1: Raw mentions 12,441 (X 4,208, news 3,117, FB 2,640, forums 1,476, TikTok 1,000). Estimated duplicates 18–22%. RSS El Financiero / Reforma / Milenio delayed 7–40 min. Cluster #88 overlap 0.73 with #91. Orphan keywords: 47.

Additional outlets at extra cost: Grupo Hoy (Puebla, Hidalgo, Tlaxcala, Nuevo León), Mundo Puebla, Mundo Nuevo León, México Vibra, and El Mundo USA.
addonPeciFeatures: SMM, ads, design, and short-form video
landing.faqTitle: What people usually ask before the demo
landing.faq1A: It is a social listening and AI sentiment analysis platform. It monitors mentions across social, blogs, and digital media in real time.
landing.faq2Q: Does it detect sarcasm or double meaning?
landing.faq2A: Yes. The AI reads the real tone of the conversation — positive, negative, or neutral — including sarcasm and double meaning in Spanish.
landing.faq3A: Two profiles: brands and companies tracking reputation and consumer sentiment, and political or government actors who need public perception, campaign narratives, and disinformation risk.
landing.faq4A: They scale by monitored profiles (2 to 5), keywords (5 to unlimited), report frequency, watermark — removed from Business up — and competitor analysis, which starts at Business.
landing.faq5A: Automatic WhatsApp or Telegram notifications when mention volume spikes or reputational risk appears. Sensitivity is configurable per project.
landing.faq6Q: What do the add-ons (plus services) include?
landing.faq6A: Reputation management and digital amplification, WhatsApp mass messaging, allied media outreach, market research, and the comprehensive communication plan (PECI). They are quoted separately, except Gold, which includes one service of your choice — PECI is always quoted on its own.
landing.faq7Q: Can I compare my brand or candidate against the competition?
landing.faq7A: Yes. Narrative comparison sits side by side, with sentiment and volume. Comparing more than two entities requires an add-on.
landing.faq8A: They export as PDF or CSV, can be scheduled automatically, and combine a narrative executive summary with supporting data. Frequency depends on the contracted plan.
landing.placeholderBody: Analyze your audience's sentiment in real time. Landing page under construction.
